title: 5 NEW Amazon Airfields, Remote Pacific Island & Tulsa Landmarks! (MSFS 2020 Marketplace)
description:
If you're looking to take your virtual flights off the beaten path or explore detailed hand-crafted VFR environments, the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2020 Marketplace just rolled out a distinctive wave of global scenery and utility add-ons! Today, we journey deep into the Brazilian rainforest across a brand-new five-airfield bush flying network, cross the Pacific to an isolated Japanese coral island, tour a hand-crafted Midwestern skyline, and inspect a wireless cockpit EFB companion app.

In this marketplace breakdown, we inspect all the airfield modeling, apron wear-and-tear, regional authenticity, and platform limitations to help you decide what's claiming top priority on your virtual SSD:

🌿 AMAZON BASIN REGIONAL NETWORK (HEAVEN DESIGNS & BLG)
We head into northern and western Brazil to tour five dedicated regional strips tailored for low-altitude bush hopping and scenic river runs:

Itacoatiara (SBIC): A vital gateway airport along the Amazon River featuring a paved runway, custom terminal building, static aircraft, and detailed apron modeling.

Barcelos (SWBC): Perched along the Rio Negro in Brazil's peacock bass sport-fishing capital, featuring updated perimeter fencing, refueling stations, and customized ramp textures.

Coari (SWCA): Positioned near the winding Rio Urucu amid breathtaking oxbow lakes, showcasing a traditional regional terminal and hangar facilities.

Lábrea (SWLB): Deep in the southern rainforest near the Trans-Amazonian Highway, highlighted by weathered asphalt cracking, ground markings, and emergency service structures.

Maués (SWMW): Located in the heart of Brazil's guaraná production, featuring custom aprons, roadside details, and regional props.

🌊 ISOLATED PACIFIC OUTPOST: KITA-DAITO (GATE 15 SCENERY)
We travel to the remote Daito archipelago in Okinawa, Japan, to inspect Kita-Daito Airport (RORK). Set against dramatic ocean coastlines, this scenic island strip features a detailed terminal building with passenger interior, custom Japanese apron signage, perimeter ground art, and blended island terrain.

🏙️ MIDWEST VFR SKYLINE: TULSA CITY LANDMARKS (IRON SIM)
Over in Oklahoma, Iron Sim delivers over 150 handcrafted 3D structures covering downtown Tulsa. We inspect the iconic skyscrapers, historic Art Deco architecture, custom night lighting, and LOD performance optimizations for smooth low-level VFR flying.

📱 COCKPIT UTILITY: ALVARO LINK (SOO SIM)
We examine the newly arrived Alvaro Link companion tool—designed to transmit live in-sim positioning directly to your phone or tablet's Alvaro navigation map without SimConnect cables or external PC software (noting account and premium tier requirements).

Which of these remote strips or city overhauls are you clearing for takeoff first? Drop your favorite pick in the comments below!

If this marketplace guide helped you navigate the latest MSFS 2020 additions, remember to hit that like button, subscribe to the channel for weekly sim coverage, and blue skies on your next flight!
